title: Late Toxicity and long-term quality of life after radiotherapy for head and neck cancer
summary: In the CLEAR study, patients with head and neck cancer who are still alive at least 5 years after radiotherapy are asked about their quality of life. This information will be used to further improve the planning of radiotherapy in the future.
conditions: Malignant neoplasms of lip, oral cavity and pharynx

interventions.name: One-time evaluation of head and neck specific quality of life using EORTC QLQ-C30, EORTC QLQ-H&N43 and MD Anderson Dysphagio Inventory and collection of data regarding sociodemographic status at least 5 years after radiotherapy. Analysis and comparison with dosimetric parameters of the radiotherapy

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
RT for head and neck cancer between 2016 and 2019 (included)
Exclusion criteria:
Patients with dementia
Patients with insufficient knowledge of German
Patients who are unable to complete the questionnaires collected in the study independently
